legend: As the Lead Exogeologist for the planet Herryng, you are tasked with surveying the "Convex Craters"—mysterious convex geological formations whose vertices align perfectly with the planet's magnetic n×n$$$n \times n$$$ coordinate grid. The survey area spans from (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$ at the bottom-left to (n,n)$$$(n, n)$$$ at the top-right.
To map the crater, you are equipped with an Ion-Scanning Camera. For any lattice point (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$, the camera returns:
I if the point is strictly inside the crater.
P if the point lies on the perimeter of the crater.
X if the point is outside the crater.
Preliminary long-range scans have already confirmed that the coordinates (1,t)$$$(1, t)$$$ and (n,b)$$$(n, b)$$$ are perimeter points (P).
The camera is energy-intensive. You are allowed a maximum of 7n$$$7n$$$ scans before the satellite loses its orbital lock.

Once the survey is complete, you must determine how much sealant is required to cover the crater. One "sealent bucket" covers exactly half of a unit square (0.5$$$0.5$$$ units of area). Print the minimum number of paint buckets needed to cover the entire crater.
input: The first line contains three integers n$$$n$$$, t$$$t$$$, and b$$$b$$$ (2≤n≤103$$$2 \le n \le 10^3$$$, 1≤t,b≤n$$$1 \le t, b \le n$$$).
output: When your program is ready to provide the final result, print a single line in the format ! p, where p$$$p$$$ represents the minimum number of paint buckets required to cover the crater.
After printing the answer, your program must immediately perform a flush operation and terminate. Do not print an additional newline character between the answer and the flush.
To query for a point (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$, print "? x y", where 1≤x,y≤n$$$1\le x,y\le n$$$. After that, print a line break and do a flush operation.

After making a query, you should read a single character c$$$c$$$. If c$$$c$$$ is 'I', (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$ is inside the polygon. If c$$$c$$$ is 'P', (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$ is on the perimeter of the polygon. If c$$$c$$$ is 'X', (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$ is strictly outside the polygon.

If at some moment your program reads 0 from the interactor, it should immediately exit (for example, by calling exit(0)). You will get a "Wrong Answer" in this case, and it means that you asked more than 7n$$$7n$$$ queries, or asked an invalid query. If you ignore this, you can get other verdicts since your program will continue to read from a closed stream. Note that printing an answer does not count as a query.
Your solution will get "Idleness Limit Exceeded" if you don't print anything or forget to flush the output, including for the final answer.

legend.ai: 作为 Herryng 星球的首席行星地质学家，你的任务是勘测“凸形陨坑”——这些神秘的凸形地质构造，其顶点与星球的磁性 n×n$$$n \times n$$$ 坐标网格完美对齐。勘测区域从左下角的 (1,1)$$$(1, 1)$$$ 延伸至右上角的 (n,n)$$$(n, n)$$$。
为了绘制陨坑地图，你配备了一台离子扫描相机。对于任意格点 (x,y)$$$(x, y)$$$，相机会返回：
如果该点严格位于陨坑内部，则返回 I。
如果该点位于陨坑边界上，则返回 P。
如果该点位于陨坑外部，则返回 X。
初步的远程扫描已经确认，坐标 (1,t)$$$(1, t)$$$ 和 (n,b)$$$(n, b)$$$ 是边界点(P)。
相机非常耗能。在卫星失去轨道锁定之前，最多允许你进行 7n$$$7n$$$ 次扫描。
勘察完成后，你必须确定覆盖火山口需要多少密封剂。一桶密封剂恰好覆盖半个单位正方形(面积 0.5$$$0.5$$$ 个单位)。输出覆盖整个火山口所需的最少涂料桶数。

output.ai: 当你的程序准备好提供最终结果时，输出一行格式为 ! p 的内容，其中 p$$$p$$$ 表示覆盖火山口所需的最少涂料桶数。
输出答案后，你的程序必须立即执行刷新操作并终止。不要在答案和刷新之间输出额外的换行符。
要查询点 (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$，请输出 "? x y"，其中 1≤x,y≤n$$$1\le x,y\le n$$$。之后输出换行并执行刷新操作。
进行查询后，你应读取一个字符 c$$$c$$$。如果 c$$$c$$$ 是 'I'，则 (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$ 在多边形内部。如果 c$$$c$$$ 是 'P'，则 (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$ 在多边形边界上。如果 c$$$c$$$ 是 'X'，则 (x,y)$$$(x,y)$$$ 严格位于多边形外部。
如果程序在某个时刻从交互器读到 0，应立即退出(例如调用 exit(0))。此时你会得到“Wrong Answer”判定，这意味着你查询了超过 7n$$$7n$$$ 次，或进行了无效查询。如果忽略这一点，由于程序会继续从已关闭的流中读取内容，你可能会得到其他判定。注意，输出答案不计为一次查询。
如果你不输出任何内容，或忘记刷新输出（包括最终答案），你的程序将得到“Idleness Limit Exceeded”判定。
